name: Electric Charge
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser electric charge except it deals 2 electricity damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are staggered until the beginning of their next turn.
